name: practice-compiler
description: Mine date-bounded Codex or Claude Code work traces for repeated tasks, recurring feedback, and follow-up instructions, then stage redacted evidence-backed proposals.

interface.shortDescription: Turn repeated work into reviewed improvements
interface.longDescription: Scan an exact session window, distinguish user, automation, subagent, and synthetic traces, group semantic variants, and stage deduplicated proposals with session-and-line evidence. Read-only stdout mode is available before persistence or approval.
defaultPrompt: Scan my recent Codex sessions for repeated friction.
Review the staged practice improvement proposals.
Prepare a handoff for this approved proposal.
